items.basis: 正文先保留可信内部 maintainer、简单约束、security invariants 已固化时使用普通 code review 与 SAST 的合理旧路径，再以 external contributor 或 mixed-trust requirement 改变信任前提。新增机制把 requirement 文本、主体/来源、revision、资产、显式目标、继承的 security invariants 与允许 trade-off 组成版本化 supply-chain artifact；coding model 只拥有 code proposal，security policy owner 定义不变量与 exception，CI 执行功能/安全回归/static analysis 并生成 receipt，repository owner 持有 merge/revert authority。收益是防止显式 usability objective 静默覆盖安全约束并建立 requirement-to-merge provenance；代价包括 specification/test 维护、CI 延迟、false reject 与 policy/test drift。正文明确列出不完整安全假设、Analyzer/Judge/静态规则盲区、动态 payload 缺失、模型同时迎合代码与测试及 benchmark overfitting，并在高风险、验证冲突或 provenance 缺失时 fail closed 到人工 security review、确定性测试/static analysis 或 approved secure template；低风险可信内部改动继续与轻量路径共存。exact-v1 边界严格限制在 75 个场景、25 个 CWE、四个模型、披露的 attack generator/judge 与 verification protocol，不把受控攻击外推为生产流行度、内部因果机制或防御有效性，且明确 immutable repository/dataset/payload revision 未披露。该段位于 Ch72 Supply-chain Integrity 的 requirement→optimization→prompt→embedding 演进起点，Ch71 仍负责 tenant identity/isolation，Ch73 仍负责 production release/recovery proof obligations，无 owner 冲突。

gate.reason: The recovered exact-v1 family is present once in the canonical Ch72 mechanism spine and passed independent owner-plus-adjacent post-write semantic audit; all eight Books integrations are verified and ordinary pending is zero.
